newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Seat spin-off takes effect, trades Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Seat spin-off takes effect, trades Jan 2.

text.p: The spin-off of Italian yellow pages publisher Seat from state telecoms holding Stet came into effect on Tuesday and the company will be listed on the bourse from January 2, a Stet statement confirmed.

Stet said Seat had been registered as a company in the northern city of Turin and stock market regulator Consob had given the go-ahead for Seat ordinary and savings shares to trade from January 2, the first trading day of 1997.
The minimum number of Seat ordinary and savings shares tradeable on the bourse has been fixed at 10,000.
Savings and ordinary shares in Stet will be modified after the spin-off and will be quoted as such from January 2.
